card.name: Slash in FDA MedWatch web address
card.fires_on: The slash or the ".gov" in an FDA web address, mainly the "/" right after www.fda.gov just before "medwatch", in the adverse-reaction reporting line of drug labels.

modes.label: Slash after fda.gov
modes.description: The "/" that follows www.fda.gov in the MedWatch reporting sentence, right before "medwatch".
modes.example: -921-7873 or FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088 or www.fda.gov<</>>medwatch. Drug Interactions: Dav

modes.label: .gov in FDA address
modes.description: The ".gov" part of an FDA web address, before a path such as medwatch or CompanionDiagnostics.
modes.example: tests for the detection of HER2 protein expression, HER2 gene amplification, and activating HER2 mutations is available at: http://www.fda<<.gov>>/CompanionDiagnostics. 2

card.plain: It marks the spot in the FDA website address where the label tells readers how to report side effects.
